offer_validity.title: Offer Validity and Pricing
offer_validity.body: This offer is valid for 14 days. Prices are subject to change due to fluctuations in raw material costs, which are beyond our control. If raw material costs increase, prices will be recalculated accordingly.

raw_materials.title: Raw Materials and Product Quality
raw_materials.body_1: Made from natural components, some products may exhibit slight colour variations between batches. These variations are a natural characteristic of the materials used and do not affect the quality of our products.
raw_materials.body_2: Each product is assigned a unique Batch Number that is tracked through all stages of manufacturing and delivery. This ensures accuracy during production and at Quality Control checks.

stability.title: Formulation and Product Stability
stability.body: Vita Manufacture can provide advice concerning formulation stability. If full stability testing is required, additional charges will apply. You are legally responsible for your product's formulation and stability. A "best before" date will be provided after the development stage as part of the label guidelines and approval process.

legality.title: Responsibilities for Product Legality and Labelling
legality.body: Vita Manufacture Ltd, as the manufacturer, assumes no responsibility for the legality of your product's formulation, labelling, presentation, promotion, or marketing. Your product label must not include Vita Manufacture's name or address. We strongly recommend seeking professional guidance from relevant regulatory authorities, such as: Health Food Manufacturers Association, Medicines and Healthcare Regulatory Agency, Food Standards Agency and Trading Standards.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.body_1: Vita Manufacture terms and conditions apply for all orders. Vita Manufacture General Terms and Conditions (T&C's) are available on https://www.vitamanufacture.co.uk/termsandcondition. Extract of T&C's is included in this document. In the event of a conflict between this offer and the T&C's, the T&C's will prevail and control.
terms.body_2: If you decide to contract with us, we kindly ask you to return this offer, and the formula agreement (Draft Product Specification Sheet) countersigned and dated to us. Upon receipt of these documents, planning for preparation of the samples will be confirmed.
terms.body_3: The information included in this document is established according to the current European Regulation. It's our customer's responsibility to check that the use and conditions of use of their product are conforming to their activities segment and geographical sales areas. Vita Manufacture manufactures and releases batches for further operations. The batches are produced according to ISO 22000:2018 standards, Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards, the European legislation for Food Supplements and Food Safety Agency UK. For one year, as of the date of your first order, Vita Manufacture shall be the exclusive manufacturer of the products and references mentioned in this offer.
terms.vat: Vita Manufacture will apply VAT to all commercial products delivered to any UK address where VAT is applicable.

closing.help: We will be pleased to assist you with any additional questions or queries.

rd.intro: Where a product requires formulation development, flavour development, sample preparation, reformulation, technical review, dossier preparation, or manufacturing validation, Vita Manufacture's R&D terms shall apply.
rd.complimentary: Complimentary Basic R&D (Free) may be included with a confirmed production order and is limited to two (2) R&D iterations per product and a maximum of two flavour options per product, where flavour development is relevant.
rd.full: The Full R&D Package (optional) is charged at £1,750 + VAT per product and includes up to seven (7) R&D iterations, product dossier preparation, Commercial playbook, Extensive label guidance, and Vita Manufacture expert list on client website where applicable and approved by Vita Manufacture.
rd.diamond: The Diamond R&D Package (optional) is charged at £3,500 + VAT per product and includes reasonable sample support within the agreed project scope, up to twelve R&D iterations, up to four flavour options, product dossier preparation, draft Product Specification Sheet, basic label guidance, expert website listing where applicable, and priority R&D scheduling where capacity allows.
rd.additional: Additional R&D samples, reformulations, flavour options, or iterations outside the agreed allowance may be charged at £250 + VAT per additional R&D sample or iteration per product.
rd.reasonable: "Reasonable sample support" means a commercially reasonable level of sampling and development support within the agreed product concept, formula direction, dosage format, target market, and product brief. It does not mean unlimited reformulation, unlimited flavour development, unlimited ingredient changes, unlimited dosage format changes, unlimited courier dispatches, unlimited product concepts, or unlimited SKUs.
rd.binding: Only the R&D scope, sample allowance, pricing, timelines, and deliverables stated in the written quotation, signed proposal, invoice, Product Specification Sheet, or written agreement shall be binding. Verbal discussions, informal assurances, or sales representations shall not amend the R&D scope unless confirmed in writing by an authorised representative of Vita Manufacture.
rd.lead_times: Manufacturing lead times shall not begin until the final Product Specification Sheet has been approved and signed, label requirements have been satisfied, required payments have been received, and all production-critical matters have been finalised.

appendix.intro: Where a product requires formulation development, flavour development, sample preparation, reformulation, technical review, dossier preparation, or manufacturing validation, the Research & Development, Sampling and Formulation Terms shall apply unless otherwise agreed in writing by Vita Manufacture Limited.
appendix.alignment: These terms are intended to ensure that the customer, Sales team, R&D team, Production team, and Quality team are fully aligned before development or manufacturing work begins.
appendix.full_terms_note: Full R&D, Sampling and Formulation Terms are recorded against this proposal and apply once the proposal is signed. Sections include: Purpose of the R&D Phase, R&D Packages, Additional Samples and Extra Iterations, Customer Feedback and Approval, Reasonable Sample Support, Material Formula Changes, Technical / Regulatory / Manufacturing Limitations, R&D Timelines, Sample Approval and Production Scale-Up, Ownership of Formulations and R&D Work, Cancellation / Delay / Non-Proceeding, and Sales Representations.
